text:
Samir: Hey all — quick onboarding questions. 1) When should I expect my first paycheck? 2) I'm an international hire and I filled the local tax form but also got the US W-4 in the portal — which one takes precedence? 3) Relocation receipts — do I just upload scans somewhere?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Samir! :tada: For pay: payroll runs on the 15th and last day of the month; new hires paid on the next run after we process your paperwork. If you started on 3/2, expect pay on 3/15.
Sana - Payroll: FYI — if your banking info and tax forms were submitted before payroll cutoff (7 days before run) you'll make the upcoming one. Otherwise next. For international folks we honor the local tax withholding form for your country if you're on a local contract. If you're on a US payroll record + living abroad, we need the W-4. If you want, DM me your country and contract type and I can confirm.
Samir: I'm on the US payroll record but working remotely from Ireland. I uploaded an Irish tax form earlier — I wasn't sure which to pick in the portal.
Jordan: Quick checklist for Samir: 1) confirm employment type (US payroll vs local) with your manager, 2) if US payroll -> complete W-4, 3) if local hire -> complete local tax form in the portal. Mana-ger note: Alex, can you confirm?
Alex (Engineering): Confirmed — Samir is on US payroll (we set it up for equity reasons). Samir, please fill out the W-4 in the benefits portal and mark your residential address as Ireland. Payroll team will handle withholding rules.
Maya (People Ops): Relocation receipts: please upload PDFs to the HR portal under Expenses -> Relocation. We need receipts + short note of purpose. Filename pattern helps us match reimbursements: e.g. `RELO_SAMIR_2026_receipt-airbnb.pdf`. If you have multiple receipts zip them up and upload one file.
Samir: Perfect — do I put a code or job ID anywhere so accounting tags it correctly?
Sana - Payroll: Yes, include the code RELO-2026 in the "Notes" field when you upload. Also add expense category "Relocation - New Hire". That ensures we route it to the right workflow and you get reimbursed on the next monthly expense run (usually the first Friday after upload).
Samir: Awesome, thanks. Any deadlines for benefits/401k/health enrollment?
Maya (People Ops): You have a 30-day window from your start date to enroll in benefits/401k. The portal will show a banner — but inbox us if you miss it and we'll do a manual enrollment if eligible.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Benefits enrollment window = 30 days from start. Docs required for dependents: birth certificate or marriage certificate + proof of coverage. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/enroll
Samir: Got it, will upload W-4 + receipts today. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
